title: Club Sandwich
description: Club Sandwich is a classic continental favorite made with three layers of toasted bread, tender chicken, crispy bacon, fresh vegetables, and creamy mayonnaise. This hotel-style sandwich is served with golden French fries and a fresh salad for a satisfying restaurant-quality meal.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: 3 slices white sandwich bread (lightly toasted, edges trimmed)
100 g cooked chicken breast (grilled or roasted, thinly sliced)
1 boiled egg (sliced) or 1 fried egg (optional, depending on style)
1 slice cheddar or Swiss cheese (optional but common in hotels)
2 tbsp mayonnaise (lightly seasoned with lemon juice & pepper)

instruction.title: 1. Prepare Ingredients
steps: Toast the bread slices lightly and keep warm.
Slice chicken, tomato, and egg. Wash and dry lettuce leaves.

instruction.title: 2. Assemble First Layer
steps: Place the first slice of bread on a board.
Add lettuce, sliced chicken, and tomato.

instruction.title: 3. Assemble Second Layer
steps: Place the second slice of bread on top. Spread mayo.
Add bacon, egg slices, and cheese (if using).

instruction.title: 4. Finish
steps: Top with the third slice of bread. Press gently.
Secure with 4 cocktail sticks (to hold shape).
Cut the sandwich diagonally into 4 triangles.

instruction.title: 5. Serve
steps: Add French fries and a small side salad for a true continental hotel presentation.

chefTips: Use farm-fresh eggs for brighter color.
Grill chicken with a touch of paprika & olive oil for flavor.
Keep fillings balanced and not too heavy, so layers stay neat.
Plate with a small ramekin of ketchup or aioli beside the fries.
